# GeeksforGeeks

> GeeksforGeeks is a comprehensive learning portal for computer science education, offering tutorials, courses, and practice problems across DSA, programming languages, web development, and AI/ML.

The platform serves as a one-stop resource for students and professionals preparing for technical interviews at top companies like Google, Amazon, and Microsoft. It provides self-paced courses, interactive coding challenges, and in-depth tutorials across multiple technology domains.

## Key Topics

- Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)
- Python
- Java
- C++
- JavaScript
- Machine Learning
- Data Science
- Web Development
- System Design
- DevOps
- Linux
- Deep Learning
- Artificial Intelligence
- Interview Preparation
- Object-Oriented Programming

## Core Platform

- [GeeksforGeeks Homepage](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org): GeeksforGeeks homepage: comprehensive learning portal for DSA, programming languages, and tech education
- [Practice Platform](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/explore): GeeksforGeeks practice platform for coding challenges and interview question preparation
- [Courses Catalog](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/courses): GeeksforGeeks course catalog: DSA, system design, data science, and web development

## Data Structures & Algorithms

- [DSA Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/dsa/dsa-tutorial-learn-data-structures-and-algorithms): DSA tutorial covering data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis, and interview prep
- [Learn DSA Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/learn-data-structures-and-algorithms-dsa-tutorial): DSA tutorial for interview prep with Google, Microsoft, Amazon, and Apple focus
- [DSA Self-Paced Course](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/courses/dsa-self-paced): DSA self-paced course: arrays, trees, graphs, sorting, and dynamic programming

## Programming Languages

- [Python Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/python-programming-language-tutorial): Python tutorial with Django, Flask, and NumPy for data science and web development
- [Java Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/java/java): Java tutorial covering OOP, syntax, data types, and JVM fundamentals for beginners
- [C++ Programming Language](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/cpp/c-plus-plus): C++ tutorial with OOP, data structures, and competitive programming fundamentals
- [C Programming Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/c/c-programming-language): C programming tutorial covering syntax, data types, control flow, and I/O fundamentals
- [JavaScript Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/javascript/javascript-tutorial): JavaScript tutorial for web development with HTML, CSS, and React frameworks

## AI, Machine Learning & Data Science

- [Machine Learning Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/machine-learning/machine-learning): Machine learning tutorial covering supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning
- [Data Science Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/data-science/data-science-for-beginners): Data science tutorial with Python, NumPy, Pandas, and machine learning introduction
- [AI, ML and Data Science Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/ai-ml-ds): AI/ML/DS tutorial: Python, deep learning, NLP, and computer vision fundamentals
- [Machine Learning Tutorial (Advanced)](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/machine-learning): Machine learning tutorial with Python and R for supervised and unsupervised learning
- [Data Science Project-Based Course](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/courses/data-science-live): Data science course with Python, SQL, and machine learning project-based learning

## Web Development & System Design

- [Web Development Technologies](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/web-development): Web development tutorial: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frontend technologies
- [System Design Course](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/courses/mastering-system-design-low-level-to-high-level-solutions): System design course: OOP, design patterns, distributed systems, and architecture

## Infrastructure & DevOps

- [Linux Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/linux-unix/linux-tutorial): Linux tutorial with commands, file systems, Docker, Kubernetes, and DevOps basics
- [DevOps Tutorial](https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/devops/devops-tutorial): DevOps tutorial covering CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes fundamentals
